decision_type: Estimated purchase utility judged by the coordinator, not actual buyer conversion.
buyer: A freelance email marketer, small agency or in-house marketer producing repeated campaigns for documented brands.
paid_job: From brand material and selected audience to a coherent sequence, with source constraints preserved through editing and an exportable chosen version.
reasons_to_pay_observed: Homepage material preparation and structured audience/product research persist across campaigns
Second campaign reuses prepared knowledge instead of rebuilding its source context
Optional instructions and fact choices preserve their scope across strategy and rewrites
Revision proposals keep originals, changes, decisions and exact selected export
writing_control: Four direct same-model controls produced useful prose when given prepared context. Paid value observed in preparation/reuse, scoped preferences, checks, revisions and exact export; no blanket prose-superiority claim.
required_before_yes: Resolve the known substantive sequence argument defect
Review all three regenerated emails against their actual evidence and CTA
Retain the same audience and inputs, without a factual override or manually authored deliverable
required_if_failed: No unresolved substantive case remains in the reviewed chosen versions.
price_conclusion: No price or buyer-count prediction is inferred from code tests or competing posted prices.
